about: Public names the app took away on purpose: a top-level name in tools/ or templates/ with no leading underscore, outside tools/openroles/, which a person's own tests may use. tools/public_names.py check fails on a name gone from tools/public_names.json unless it is listed here with the date, the reason and the CHANGELOG line that tells people, and that line is in CHANGELOG.md. Each entry: {"module": "tools/<file>.py", "name": "<name>", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "reason": "<why it went>", "changelog": "<the CHANGELOG line, as written there>"}.

removed.name: BREW
removed.reason: the computer set-up no longer installs Homebrew: tools/installs.py puts what is missing in the person's own folders, with no password
removed.changelog: **Four messages your own checks might have named were retired**: `env_check.BREW`, `place.SHORT_SIGN_IN`, `place.SHORT_TWO_CHATS` and `place.SIGN_IN_ONCE`. The reading step now asks for the LinkedIn sign-in itself, once, when it finds you signed out; the set-up of a computer needs no Homebrew; and no chat on the computer is recommended for everything.
